description: Find accessible elements by role / name / text in a desktop capsule. Each match has a center (cx, cy) to click.

exact.description: Require an exact match instead of a substring

role.description: Accessible role, e.g. 'button', 'menu item', 'text', 'terminal' (Linux AT-SPI) or 'Button', 'Edit' (Windows UI Automation)

text.description: Match against the name OR the value

name: capsulate_find_element
title: Find UI elements
